title: Gateway event envelope
description: The one envelope every service publishes (D-08). Frozen at G1: a change here is a change to every consumer. data carries identifiers, versions, states and amounts only — never personal, tax or registration attributes, which consumers fetch through the gateway under their own authorisation and consent.

eventId.description: Unique per event. Consumers deduplicate on this, so a replay is safe.

eventType.description: domain.aggregate.action.vN — e.g. demand.opportunity.published.v1. A breaking change is a new .v2 published alongside .v1 until consumers migrate.

eventTimestamp.description: UTC, when the state change committed — not when it was published.

producer.description: The owning module, not the deployable it currently runs in.

actor.description: Who caused this. A scheduled job uses the service's own identity.

actingFor.description: Entity UAID when acting under a delegation.

data.description: Identifiers, versions, states and amounts. The event lint rejects personal, tax and registration fields at any depth.

correlationId.description: Carried unchanged across every hop of one user action.

causationId.description: The eventId that caused this one.

audit.description: Present on events that record a state change the audit chain must carry (ADR-0003).
